# huginhelm Godot 4 starter kits – full details

> Godot 4.7 starter kits / templates. Lite = free MIT on GitHub, Pro = paid commercial EULA on itch.io (EUR).

# Factory Core – Godot 4 factory / automation starter kit / template

URL: https://openclawaimac.github.io/factory-core/
Lite (free, MIT, 65 tests): https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-factory-core-lite
Pro (€16.00 EUR, commercial per-seat EULA, 249 tests): https://huginhelm.itch.io/factory-core
Engine: Godot 4.7 (tested 4.7.2), typed GDScript, version 0.5.0. Run tests: `bash tools/run_tests.sh`.

Deterministic, headless-tested belts, machines and power for your Godot 4 automation game.

## Features (Pro)
- Flow-graph belt simulation with gap-based belt lines (no per-item physics); two-lane belts with side-loading and underground tunnels
- Machines with input/output buffers and recipes, Mk1–Mk3 tiers (speed/power per mille), recipe switching
- Splitters with filter and fair mergers
- Power grid with generators and brownout
- Throughput stats and a heuristic bottleneck finder with colour overlay (idle/working/starved/blocked/no power)
- Deterministic fixed tick – `FactorySim.step(n)` runs fully headless
- Grid build mode: data-driven hotbar, ghost preview (valid/invalid), rotation, drag-placed belt lines with auto-connect, removal with refund and cost hooks
- Undo/redo (restores items of removed nodes), blueprints: capture, rotate, paste, serialize
- Items, recipes and buildables as Resources or loaded from JSON, with `FactoryDB.validate()`
- JSON save/load with migrations
- Camera pan/zoom and a 120x80 demo map with iron/copper ore fields (drills need ore)
- JSON build scripts for starter layouts; reskin via `skin.json` + PNGs
- Demo chain: ore → plates → gears, wire → circuits → motors (8 items, 6 recipes, 15 buildables)

## Not included
- 1x1 buildables only; no inserters/arms, fluids, trains, robots or logic network
- One power network per sim; no poles, fuel or accumulators
- Bottleneck finder is a heuristic, not full flow analysis
- Tested headless on Godot 4.7.2 (plus scripted headless-Chrome run of the web build); real browsers/devices not tested

## Lite vs Pro
| Feature | Lite (MIT) | Pro (EULA) |
|---|---|---|
| Data-driven items/recipes/buildables (Resources or JSON) | ✅ | ✅ |
| Deterministic headless sim, throughput stats | ✅ | ✅ |
| Two-lane belts with side-loading, backpressure | ✅ | ✅ |
| Source, sink, machines (recipes, buffers) | ✅ Mk1 | ✅ Mk1–Mk3 tiers, recipe switching |
| Splitter and fair merger | ✅ | ✅ + filter splitter |
| Underground tunnels | – | ✅ |
| Power grid, generators, brownout | – | ✅ |
| Bottleneck finder + colour overlay | – | ✅ |
| JSON save/load | ✅ basic | ✅ + versioned migrations |
| Grid build mode: ghost, drag belts, auto-connect, refund, hotbar | – | ✅ |
| Undo/redo, blueprints | – | ✅ |
| Playable demo game, camera, ore map, inspector | Minimal debug scene | ✅ |
| Pixel art, sfx, music (CC0) | – | ✅ |
| Headless tests | Lite subset | ✅ 249 checks |
| Web export preset, build scripts, reskin | – | ✅ |
| Licence | MIT | Commercial EULA (per seat) |

Assets: Original 16x16 pixel art (generated by included script), Kenney CC0 sfx, two CC0 music tracks from OpenGameArt.


# Godot Survival Core – Godot 4 survival crafting starter kit / template

URL: https://openclawaimac.github.io/godot-survival-core/
Lite (free, MIT, 48 tests): https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-survival-core-lite
Pro (€12.00 EUR, commercial per-seat EULA, 144 tests): https://huginhelm.itch.io/godot-survival-core
Engine: Godot 4.7 (tested 4.7.2), typed GDScript, version 0.4.0. Run tests: `bash tools/run_tests.sh`.

Needs, gathering, inventory, crafting, base building and versioned saves – typed, tested, ready to extend.

## Features (Pro)
- SurvivalStats: hunger/thirst drain, starvation damage, regeneration, `died` signal
- DayNightClock: time of day, phases, `day_started`, `light_level()`; demo day/night tint and music crossfade
- Inventory with slot and stack limits, atomic `remove_all`, `set_count`, `take_all`
- RecipeBook: data-driven recipes with optional crafting-station tag
- BaseBuilder + StructureDef: grid placement with "near X" rules, storage containers, crafting stations, `craft_near`
- Gatherable resource nodes with hits, depletion and respawn
- SaveGame: versioned JSON save, migration hooks, atomic write; WorldNodes makes spawned children savable
- Pure-logic systems with manual `tick`/`advance` – everything testable headless
- Playable demo: top-down movement with collision, 4-direction walk animation, HUD need bars, inventory grid, crafting panel, chest UI, mouse placement with green/red ghost
- All demo content (items, recipes, structures, resource nodes, sounds, needs) is data in `content.json`

## Not included
- No combat, enemies or night raids
- No temperature, tool durability, farming or tech tree
- 1-cell structures, no rotation; removal does not refund
- No multiplayer; saves are plain JSON
- Tested headless on Godot 4.7.2 (plus scripted headless-Chrome run of the web export); real browsers/devices not tested

## Lite vs Pro
| Feature | Lite (MIT) | Pro (EULA) |
|---|---|---|
| SurvivalStats: hunger/thirst, starvation, regen | ✅ | ✅ |
| DayNightClock | ✅ | ✅ + demo light tint and music crossfade |
| Inventory (slots, stacks) | ✅ | ✅ |
| RecipeBook (data-driven crafting) | ✅ hand crafting | ✅ + crafting stations |
| Gatherable resource nodes | ✅ | ✅ |
| BuildGrid + BaseBuilder (near-X rules, storage, stations) | – | ✅ |
| SaveGame (versioned JSON, migrations) + WorldNodes | – | ✅ |
| Content data (content.json) | Small sample | ✅ full set |
| Playable demo: controller, HUD, inventory grid, crafting & chest UI, placement ghost | Minimal example scene | ✅ |
| Art + music (Ninja Adventure, Kenney – CC0) | – | ✅ |
| Headless tests | Lite subset | ✅ 144 checks |
| Licence | MIT | Commercial EULA (per seat) |

Assets: Ninja Adventure by Pixel-boy & AAA (most art + music) and Kenney (sfx, icons) – all CC0.


# Godot Tower Defense Core – Godot 4 tower defense starter kit / template

URL: https://openclawaimac.github.io/godot-tower-defense-core/
Lite (free, MIT, 54 tests): https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-tower-defense-core-lite
Pro (€6.00 EUR, commercial per-seat EULA, 128 tests): https://huginhelm.itch.io/godot-tower-defense-core
Engine: Godot 4.7 (tested 4.7.2), typed GDScript, version 0.3.0. Run tests: `bash tools/run_tests.sh`.

Data-driven towers, enemies and waves with upgrades, targeting and flyers – typed, headless-tested, ready to reskin.

## Features (Pro)
- TDContent: towers, enemies, waves and the map in one JSON file, with `validate()`
- TDMap: cell grid with path / blocked / buildable cells, world ↔ cell conversion, validation
- TDEnemy: follows a polyline path; hp, speed, armor (flat reduction), slow, bounty, leak damage, flying flag
- TDTower: hitscan towers with FIRST / LAST / STRONGEST / CLOSEST targeting, splash, slow, air/ground filter, DPS readout
- Data-driven upgrade levels and sell refund (70% of gold spent)
- TDWaveSpawner: data-driven waves with per-wave HP scaling, wave-clear bonus, next-wave preview, placement rules, sell, win/lose signals
- TDEconomy: gold, lives and a `defeated` signal
- Headless-friendly: `auto_tick = false` + `advance(delta)` drives the whole game from tests
- Playable demo: 4 towers, 6 enemy types (incl. flyers and a boss), 12 waves; build bar, hover/upgrade panel with targeting toggle, wave preview, win/lose screen
- Demo juice: recoil, muzzle flash, explosions, floating numbers; camera pan/zoom; 1x/2x/3x speed, pause, mute
- Kenney CC0 sprites, sfx and jingles, "Battle Theme A" (CC0) music; HTML5 web demo

## Not included
- One fixed path per map (no maze building / pathfinding); single map in the demo
- Hitscan towers – no projectile physics
- No save/load, meta-progression, hero units or abilities
- No multiplayer
- Tested headless on Godot 4.7.2 (plus scripted headless-Chrome run of the web export); real browsers/devices not tested

## Lite vs Pro
| Feature | Lite (MIT) | Pro (EULA) |
|---|---|---|
| Core scripts: TDContent, TDMap, TDEnemy, TDTower, TDWaveSpawner, TDEconomy | ✅ same 6 scripts | ✅ |
| Targeting modes, splash, slow, air/ground, armor, flyers, upgrade levels, sell refund | ✅ | ✅ |
| JSON content (towers, enemies, waves, map) | Small sample: 2 towers, 2 enemies, 3 waves | ✅ 4 towers, 6 enemies, 12 waves |
| Playable demo | Minimal demo (build, sell, next wave) | ✅ full demo: HUD build bar, hover/upgrade panel, wave preview, win/lose screen |
| Camera pan/zoom, game speed, pause, mute | – | ✅ |
| Juice: recoil, muzzle flash, explosions, floating numbers | – | ✅ |
| Sprites (Kenney CC0) | ✅ | ✅ |
| Sound effects, jingles, music (CC0) | – | ✅ |
| Headless tests | ✅ 54 checks | ✅ 128 checks |
| Web export preset, capture tooling, AGENTS.md / llms.txt, design notes | – | ✅ |
| Licence | MIT | Commercial EULA (per seat) |

Assets: Kenney Tower Defense (top-down) sprites, Kenney sfx/jingles/fonts, "Battle Theme A" by cynicmusic – all CC0.


# Godot RTS Advanced – Godot 4 3D real-time strategy (RTS) starter kit / template

URL: https://openclawaimac.github.io/godot-rts-advanced/
Lite (free, MIT, 114 tests): https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-rts-advanced-lite
Pro (€19.00 EUR, commercial per-seat EULA, 356 tests): https://huginhelm.itch.io/godot-rts-advanced
Engine: Godot 4.7 (tested 4.7.2), typed GDScript, version 0.3.0. Run tests: `bash tools/run_tests.sh`.

Terrain, cover, fog of war, construction, harvesting and an AI opponent – a typed, headless-tested 3D RTS framework with a playable skirmish.

## Features (Pro)
- Selection: drag box with live unit count, click, shift-add, ctrl-toggle, control groups, type counts
- Orders and formations: box and line slots facing the direction of travel, crossing-free slot assignment, per-unit reserved destinations so groups never pile up
- Terrain with plateaus, ramps and cliffs: height, normals, line of sight, render mesh with cliff walls
- Cliff-aware A* pathfinding with slope cost, building footprints, crowd cost and an occupancy grid
- Combat: weapons with damage, penetration, accuracy, range and interval; directional light/heavy cover, height advantage, front/side/rear armour, suppression meter; seeded RNG
- Production: many producers per team, unit requirements, population cap, pause/repeat, rally points, refund when a producer dies; squad templates built from a selection
- Harvesting: resource fields with depletion/regrowth and worker slots, gather → carry → unload cycle
- Construction: placement preview and checks (flat ground, occupancy, build radius), paid build sites, cancel/sell refunds, team power with low-power slowdown
- Fog of war per team (unexplored / explored / visible), height-aware sight, shared vision
- AI opponent with Easy/Normal/Hard, build order, army mix and attack/retreat – acts only through the player systems (no map hacks)
- Save/load: versioned JSON snapshot with checksum, tamper and version checks; minimap with fog, markers, click to jump and right-click to command
- Camera, key rebinding with conflict check, localization with live language switch (en/fr)
- Playable skirmish demo: 5 unit types, 6 buildings, full HUD and minimap; unit and building catalogs are data, so new unit types need no code

## Not included
- One skirmish map and one AI opponent in the demo; no campaign or map editor
- No multiplayer / networking
- Compatibility renderer: no real-time shadows in the demo (blob shadows and baked AO instead); switch to Forward+ for real shadows
- Tested headless on Godot 4.7.2 (plus scripted headless-Chrome run of the web export); real browsers/devices not tested

## Lite vs Pro
| Feature | Lite (MIT) | Pro (EULA) |
|---|---|---|
| Core: teams, selection box, control groups, orders, formations, grid A*, units, production queue, resources, camera, key rebinding, localization | ✅ same core scripts | ✅ |
| Terrain heights: plateaus, ramps, cliffs, line of sight | – | ✅ |
| Cliff-aware pathfinding with occupancy and reserved group destinations | Flat grid A* | ✅ |
| Combat: cover, facing armour, suppression, weapons | Basic attack (range, cooldown) | ✅ |
| Multi-producer production, population cap, squad templates | Single queue per producer | ✅ |
| Harvesting (fields, workers, drop-offs) | Capturable income points | ✅ + income points |
| Construction with placement preview, power | – | ✅ |
| Fog of war, minimap | – | ✅ |
| AI opponent (3 difficulties) | – | ✅ |
| Save/load (versioned, checksum) | – | ✅ |
| Playable demo | Primitive-shape demo (select, move, produce units, capture) | ✅ full 3D skirmish vs AI with HUD |
| 3D models, UI, sfx, music (CC0) + original buildings | – (primitive meshes) | ✅ |
| Headless tests | ✅ 114 checks | ✅ 356 checks |
| Web export preset, capture/icon/building tools | – | ✅ |
| Licence | MIT | Commercial EULA (per seat) |

Assets: Kenney Space Kit models, UI Pack: Space Expansion, fonts and sci-fi/interface sounds (CC0), two CC0 music loops by congusbongus, plus original generated 3D buildings.


# Godot Destruction Core – Godot 4 2D destruction, collapse & chain reaction kit

URL: https://openclawaimac.github.io/godot-destruction-core/
Lite (free, MIT, 82 tests): https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-destruction-core-lite
Pro (€16.00 EUR, commercial per-seat EULA, 142 tests): https://huginhelm.itch.io/godot-destruction-core
Engine: Godot 4.6+ (tested 4.7.2), typed GDScript, version 0.2.2. Run tests: `bash tools/run_tests.sh`.

## Features
- Destructible cell terrain: integer hit points, resistances, anchors, rubble; circle, rect, line and cell damage with falloff
- Structural collapse with a resumable support check (no size cap), falling pieces, rubble and crush damage
- DKStress (Pro): load-based shear and crush failure, budgeted sweeps, analysis-only heat map
- DKChainReactor (Pro): fuses, merging, per-tick budget, runaway caps, barrels/triggers, explosive materials, one hitstop per chain
- DKFire (Pro): deterministic spread, burn-out to ash/charcoal, burnt supports collapse, flames ride falling pieces and light barrels
- DKMaskAdapter (Pro): alpha/palette images to terrain, mask carve stamps, grid to image
- Debug overlays (Pro): chain graph, stress heat map, "why did this fall?" inspector, frame-budget HUD
- DKCommandLog (Pro): record and replay to an identical hash with checkpoints, save/load
- Per-player credit for every blast, collapse, chain and fire; SHA-256 state digest, snapshot/restore
- Pure typed GDScript, no GDExtension; web builds of both demos with pixel-art smoke, fire and shock-ring effects

## Not included
- Cell-based, not per-pixel or rigid-body fracture; pieces do not collide in the air
- No networking
- Tested headless on Godot 4.7.2 and 4.6 and in headless Chrome; real browsers/devices not tested

## Lite vs Pro
| Feature | Lite (MIT) | Pro (EULA) |
|---|---|---|
| Cell grid, materials (integer hp, resistances, anchors, rubble), damage shapes with falloff | ✅ | ✅ |
| Single detonations, budgeted scheduler, signals | ✅ | ✅ |
| Determinism: integer state, SHA-256 digest, snapshot/restore, per-player instigator credit | ✅ | ✅ |
| Structural collapse: resumable support check (no size cap), falling pieces, rubble, crush damage | ✅ | ✅ |
| Debris pool, basic feel (shake, once-per-chain hitstop, reduced motion) | ✅ | ✅ |
| TileMapLayer renderer, per-chunk merged collision | ✅ | ✅ |
| Demo UI kit: own pixel font, styled HUD, comic callouts (MIT) | ✅ | ✅ |
| Chain reactions (`DKChainReactor`): fuses, merging, per-tick budget, runaway caps, barrels/triggers, explosive materials | – | ✅ |
| Fire (`DKFire`): deterministic spread, burn-out to ash/charcoal, burnt supports collapse, flames light barrels | – | ✅ |
| Load-based stress (`DKStress`): shear and crush failure, budgeted sweeps, analysis-only heat map | – | ✅ |
| Image/mask import (`DKMaskAdapter`): alpha or palette images to the grid, mask carve stamps, grid to image | – | ✅ |
| Debug overlays: chain graph, stress heat map, "why did this fall?" inspector, frame-budget HUD | – | ✅ |
| Command log and replay (`DKCommandLog`): record, replay to an identical hash, checkpoints, save/load | – | ✅ |
| Demos | "Collapse" (2 local players) | + "Fire Sale" run-and-gun demo (O = debug overlays) |
| Web builds (HTML5 export presets) | Collapse | + Fire Sale |
| Headless tests | 82 | 142 (82 Lite + 60 Pro) |
| Licence | MIT | Commercial per-seat EULA |
